meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 它会读取你的本地视频,提取语音转成文字稿,再按说话内容设计一组带时间的图形卡片(标题、引语、数据标注等)叠加在视频上,输出新的 MP4。原视频画面不动,可自选 16:9、9:16 或 4:5 画布。
howto.when: 当你请求添加 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 或 “package / dress up my video”(图形覆盖、屏幕图形、包装视频)时触发;纯字幕等其他意图交给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给我的访谈视频加上动态标题和引语卡片。
say.note: 自动转录并按说话内容生成卡片。

say.text: 把这个视频做成竖版 9:16,配数据标注。
say.note: 输出竖屏 MP4,原画面不动。

say.text: 用图形覆盖装饰我的播客视频,输出 MP4。
say.note: 卡片会与语音时间对齐。

howto.what_en: Reads your local video, transcribes it, designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) synced to speech, overlays them on the untouched clip, and renders MP4. Canvas 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', or 'package / dress up my video'. Other intents like plain subtitles go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add animated titles and quote cards to my interview video.
say_en.note: It transcribes and overlays designed cards.

say_en.text: Make this video 9:16 portrait with data callouts.
say_en.note: Outputs a portrait MP4 with graphics.

say_en.text: Dress up my podcast video with graphic overlays, output MP4.
